**In one line**: The Seattle Times reports that the FBI has arrested an OpenAI employee accused of planting a recording device in a company conference room.

### Key Points
- An OpenAI employee was reportedly taken into custody by the Federal Bureau of Investigation.
- The employee is accused of secretly placing a recording device in one of the company's conference rooms.
- The arrest was reported by The Seattle Times on October 14, 2026.
- The purpose of the recordings, whether any material left the company, and the specific charges have not been made public.

### Why It Matters
Because a federal agency is involved, the case may go beyond a breach of internal policy. It shows how sensitive model roadmaps and strategy discussions inside frontier AI labs have become. The incident may push companies across the industry to review their insider-threat controls and how they protect trade secrets.
